proposalsTable.intro: A ticked row is accepted when you apply. Rows scoring at least the threshold start ticked. A row with neither box ticked stays undecided.
proposalsTable.applied: {{accepted}} accepted, {{notAgain}} not to be recommended again.
proposalsTable.none: This run has no proposal left to decide.

reason.invalid_shape: Not a relationship as asked for: a field is missing or has the wrong form
reason.unknown_column: Names a table or column the request did not compare
reason.not_comparable: The two columns have different classes, so they are not compared
reason.below_threshold: Scored under the {{threshold}}% a suggestion is kept at.
reason.both_repeating: Values repeat on both sides, so neither is the one side
reason.matches_foreign_key: Matches a foreign key found in this run
reason.out_of_scope: Outside the chosen source and target tables
reason.weaker: A stronger proposal of the same two columns was kept

proposalsTable.thresholdHint: Your own threshold, kept for your next runs.

measure.inTarget: {{found}} of {{values}} source values are in the target.
measure.inTargetFirst: {{found}} of the first {{values}} source values are in the target.
measure.inSource: {{found}} of {{values}} target values are in the source.
measure.inSourceFirst: {{found}} of the first {{values}} target values are in the source.

notRead.source: The source was not read: its table requires a parameter.
notRead.target: The target was not read: its table requires a parameter.

notReadable.source: You cannot read the source column.
notReadable.target: You cannot read the target column.

measure.modelScore: Scored by the model: no values were compared.

proposalsTable.manyToMany: Neither column's values are distinct, so no relationship starts at one and ends at the other's key. It cannot be accepted.
